creator: GitHub Copilot, original static pixel-grid drawings commissioned for this project

rights: Original project contribution; no third-party attribution or asset restrictions introduced. Repository-wide licensing remains the maintainer's decision.

prohibited_motifs: No arrows, arrowheads, corner beams, text or decorative guides in these glyphs.
integration: Parent-owned route presentation may alternate these textures, rotate +X to each route tangent and animate opacity. Raster shoe anatomy remains authoritative. Do not stretch the sole or change player/navigation collision.
validation: tests/knowledge_plate_art_test.gd; contact sheet includes native-size and 4x nearest previews.
